findings.issue: Splitting the sentence weakens the core causal claim. CURRENT states that phenotype results from the interaction between genotype and environmental conditions. PROPOSED says that phenotype results from genotype and only separately states that the genotype interacts with environmental conditions, so the core idea no longer explicitly identifies that interaction as producing phenotype and can be read as genotype-only determination.
findings.evidence: CURRENT: "Phenotype results from genotype interacting with environmental conditions." PROPOSED: "Phenotype results from genotype." and "That genotype interacts with environmental conditions."
